stage: development data diagnostics only; no model or accuracy selection
analysis_unit: one fixed development world; hops are not independent worlds
diagnostic_interpretation: All atomic facts are training data. OOD means absence of constituent facts from composition training. Suffix counts use evaluation labels descriptively and do not establish a learned shortcut.

warnings: Training request capped at eligible pool

interpretation.atomic_coverage: data availability only; does not establish model mastery
interpretation.ood: all facts are atomic training facts; none has composite-training experience
interpretation.suffix: empirical within-split target concentration; singleton suffixes score 1; not a predictor, generalization bound, or evidence that the model ignores head
interpretation.majority: within-split descriptive ceiling plus fixed training-majority fraction
